protocol.status: Exploratory continuation after failed daily and continuous-channel designs; all historical periods were inspected before this experiment
protocol.hypothesis: Concentrating signals around the New York cash opening range may identify directional intraday movement while avoiding continuous chop and prolonged funding exposure
protocol.budget: One session hypothesis, exactly two entry routes: direct close breakout and first boundary-rejection retest. No time, target, trend or range parameter search in this experiment.

clock.eligible_days: Monday-Friday by New York calendar; not an exchange holiday calendar
clock.entry_signal_bars: Bars opening at or after10:00 and before13:00; orders fill next open, at or before13:00
clock.flat: 16:00 next open after the15:45 bar closes; no overnight holding
clock.dst: IANA timezone conversion; no fixed UTC offset

shared_rules.range_filter: Opening range width between1 and4 times ATR14 at the10:00 range close, inclusive
shared_rules.trend: Previous completed4h close above EMA50 with rising EMA for long, below EMA50 with falling EMA for short
shared_rules.one_setup: First trend-aligned closing range breakout consumes that day's setup, including a later payoff skip or expired retest
shared_rules.long_stop: Opening range low minus0.25 frozen opening-range ATR, rounded down
shared_rules.short_stop: Opening range high plus0.25 frozen opening-range ATR, rounded up
shared_rules.target: Fixed3 times the signal-close-to-stop distance from signal close, rounded conservatively
shared_rules.payoff_gate: At least1.5 net modeled reward/stopped risk including fees, slip and0.25ATR gap reserve

candidates.name: ny_or_direct
candidates.entry: Closed15m crossing beyond the completed opening range in4h trend direction; market next5m open

candidates.name: ny_or_retest
candidates.entry: After the same first breakout, wait up to4 later15m bars for the first touch of the broken boundary. Require directional candle and close outside boundary, no farther than half the range width beyond it. First touch failing rejection, opposite range-stop breach, timeout or end of entry window consumes the setup. Entry market next5m open; breakout candle cannot also be its retest.

execution.funding: Actual Binance rates applied before open exits to already carried quantity, with5m opening price as mark proxy
execution.bracket_path: Stop-first on ambiguous5m touches; protective stop active on entry subbar; adverse gaps slip; limit targets do not get favorable improvement
execution.entry_gap: Submission sizing and bracket freeze; actual-fill risk/geometry diagnostics do not retroactively undo fills
execution.capital: Independent continuous100k account for each multi-year comparison; no within-period resets

protocol.selection: Among candidates passing all criteria, choose largest minimum across the two periods of net divided by5m-close drawdown
protocol.publication: Publish both routes and all stresses. Passing qualifies only for an experimental Pine prototype, not an independently verified profitable strategy. No weakened gates or retrospectively optimized session settings.
